name: Little Capella
description: Little Capella was a planet in the Little Capella system in the Gordian Reach, a region in the Outer Rim Territories. In 2 ABY, the company Rapora Mining operated the Rapora Mining Center on Little Capella as one of many new facilities throughout the Outer Rim.
